recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Bird use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

items.label: Open settings
items.description: At the top of the command center, select the settings button beside Auto Bird.

steps.title: Set stationing time and sending rules

items.label: Random delay range · Min
items.description: Set the shortest number of hours troops will stay at the alliance destination after travel completes.
items.recommendation: 6 hours stationed at the alliance target after arrival.

items.label: Random delay range · Max
items.description: Set the longest stay at the destination; Auto Bird chooses a random duration between Min and Max.
items.recommendation: 12 hours stationed at the alliance target after arrival.

items.label: Minimum to send
items.description: Set the minimum total number of eligible troops needed after castle reserves are kept; this is a threshold, not the exact number sent.
items.recommendation: 0 troops, so any nonempty eligible group can go after castle reserves are kept.

items.label: Minimum RPT (remaining protection time)
items.description: Use targets with more than this many days of protection remaining; 0 removes the check.
items.recommendation: 3 days; a target must have more than 3 days of remaining protection time.

image.alt: Auto Bird stationing delay, minimum send, minimum RPT, and preset controls
image.caption: Set stationing time and eligibility, then review the Everyday reserve preset before saving.

steps.title: Choose troops to keep in each castle

items.label: Add unit
items.description: For each castle, choose troop types to keep at home instead of sending; an empty reserve leaves all eligible troops available after automatic reserves.
items.recommendation: Choose the troop types each castle needs for defense or other regular jobs.

items.label: Quantity
items.description: Set a positive quantity of each chosen troop to keep in that castle; 0 does not reserve the whole type.
items.recommendation: Keep the number of each troop type this castle needs at home for defense or other jobs; review actual troop counts.

items.label: Remove unit
items.description: Remove a unit tile to stop reserving that type in the selected castle.

items.label: Auto Fortress reserve
items.description: When Auto Fortress locks all Direwolves here, this automatic reserve is not saved in Auto Bird presets and any earlier manual Direwolf amount returns when the lock ends.

image.alt: Auto Bird castle reserve tiles for fictional Example Castle
image.caption: Reserve only the units needed at this castle; Unit 101 and Unit 102 are fictional troop placeholders.

items.label: Preset name
items.description: Enter a name for a new preset or edit the applied preset’s name before saving changes.
items.recommendation: Use a recognizable name such as Everyday.

items.label: Load preset
items.description: Choose a saved preset in the list, or choose Saved configuration to use the stored settings without a named preset.
items.recommendation: Use the intended everyday preset as the runtime default: select it, Apply, then Save changes.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Load the selected preset into this settings draft; select Save changes to commit it as the runtime default.

items.label: Save as new
items.description: Immediately save the current settings as a new named preset and select it as the runtime default.

items.label: Delete
items.description: After confirmation, immediately delete the selected preset and clear the runtime default if it was selected.

items.label: Runtime default
items.description: The runtime default is the saved active preset, or the saved configuration when no preset is active.

steps.title: Set the schedule, save and enable

items.label: Calendar
items.description: Choose when Auto Bird may run and select Save Schedule for your changes.
items.recommendation: Leave the schedule off for ongoing operation, or set usual weekly hours and Save Schedule.

items.label: Specify Preset Per Period
items.description: Choose a saved preset for a calendar period when that period should override the runtime default.
items.recommendation: Off unless different periods need different reserves.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Save the settings draft and any applied preset changes; reading this guide does not save them.

items.label: Auto Bird switch
items.description: Turn on Auto Bird at the top of the command center after saving to allow its normal castle cycles.
items.recommendation: Turn Auto Bird on after saving; the header status shows each castle’s cycle.
